name: Cloves

low.description: About 1/4 teaspoon ground or 2-3 whole cloves

siboNotes: Cloves are naturally FODMAP-free and may have antimicrobial properties that could be beneficial for SIBO management when used in typical culinary amounts.
preparationTips: Use whole cloves in slow-cooked dishes and remove before serving
Grind whole cloves fresh for maximum flavor and potency
Start with small amounts as cloves have a very strong, warming flavor
Store in airtight containers away from light to preserve essential oils
